title: SG-11.2.1 Subscribe BootScene.create to the transitionTo event
summary: BootScene.create listens for transitionTo on the React-to-Phaser bus, fades the camera out, then starts the named scene.
description: Context: ReactToPhaserEvents already declares transitionTo { sceneId } in game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts and BootScene.create already subscribes to playAnimation, but nothing listens for transitionTo. Desired behavior: create() subscribes to transitionTo; the handler fades the main camera out and, when the fade completes, starts the scene named in the event. Expected result: emitting transitionTo from React changes the active Phaser scene after a fade. Why: part of SG-11 so the React UI can drive scene changes. Shutdown cleanup is the separate sub-goal SG-11.2.2.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create has run, when reactToPhaser emits transitionTo with { sceneId: 'library' }, then cameras.main.fadeOut is called once.
Given the fade-out has been requested, when the camera fires its fade-out-complete event, then scene.start is called once with 'library'.
Given the fade-out has not completed, when transitionTo is handled, then scene.start has not been called yet.

in_scope: Fade the main camera out and start the target scene on completion
out_of_scope: Defining new scenes or changing the event payload type
preserve: Existing playAnimation subscription and shutdown handling
Typed event bus API in events.ts

technical_constraints: Use the existing reactToPhaser bus; no new dependencies
definition_of_done: Handler subscribed in create() and behaves per the acceptance criteria
